Color identity: UB | Bracket: Ruthless | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {3}{U}{U} each turn
Produces: Infinite turns; Lock
Start: Vampire Charmseeker (battlefield); Followed Footsteps (battlefield); Capture of Jingzhou (hand)

  Repeat.

  Repeat.

## Combo 101-972-2792
Cards: Saheeli's Artistry + Vampire Charmseeker + Great Whale
Color identity: UB | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {3}{U}{U}
Produces: Infinite artifact ETB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite storm count; Infinite creature tokens; Infinite mana lands you control can produce; Infinite magecraft triggers; Infinite recursion of instant and sorcery cards from your graveyard; Infinite copies of all creatures; Infinite copies of all artifacts; Infinite untap of lands you control
Start: Saheeli's Artistry (hand); Vampire Charmseeker (battlefield); Great Whale (hand)
Prerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
Steps: Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
  Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is an artifact.
  When the Great Whale token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
  Cast Vampire Charmseeker by paying its mana cost.
  When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
  Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
  Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Vampire Charmseeker and the Great Whale token.
  When the Vampire Charmseeker and Great Whale tokens enter, they trigger.
  Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
  Resolve the Great Whale token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
  Repeat from step 6.
Notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Great Whale and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Vampire Charmseeker instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.

Color identity: UB | Bracket: Oddball | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {3}{U}{U}{B}
Produces: Infinite +1/+1 counters on a creature; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite magecraft triggers
Start: Naru Meha, Master Wizard (hand); Shallow Grave (hand); Hammerhead, Maggia Boss (battlefield)

  Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
  When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Shallow Grave.

  Repeat from step 3.
